essence: The goddess manifests with distinctive eyes and actively protects her devotees.
The goddess is defined by abundant and thunderous sonic power.
The goddess is singular, disciplined in celibacy, honored by true means, and linked to Kubera.
The goddess alleviates poverty and sorrow and destroys even terrible distress.
The goddess is Lakshmi, born from the milk ocean, lotus-associated, and supporter of the earth.
